description.value: Bufala Edgemont is a Napolitana-style pizzeria and full-service Italian restaurant situated in Edgemont Village on the North Shore, just minutes from Grouse Mountain and the Capilano Suspension Bridge. The kitchen fires scratch-made pizzas in an 800-degree stone oven and rounds out the menu with Italian-inspired small plates, pasta, and desserts alongside cocktails, wines, and craft beers. The restaurant earned Best New Restaurant 2020 and is a popular stop for visitors to the North Shore mountains.
